sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 20. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 10, and it is perpendicular to the third side
10, and it is parallel to the third side
20, and it is parallel to the third side
40, and it is parallel to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent, after constructing the bisector of the apex angle. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The bisector is perpendicular to the base by definition.
The base angles look equal in the diagram.
The two smaller triangles are congruent by SAS, so their corresponding base angles are congruent.
All triangles have congruent base angles.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 92°. Find the measure of the alternate interior angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 47° and 33°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 116°. Find the consecutive angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 120. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 60, and it is perpendicular to the third side
120, and it is parallel to the third side
60, and it is parallel to the third side
240, and it is parallel to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that the diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The diagonals are perpendicular, which forces bisection.
Alternate interior angles give two pairs of congruent angles, and the opposite sides are congruent, so the triangles formed are congruent by ASA.
Every quadrilateral has diagonals that bisect each other.
The diagonals are congruent, so they must bisect each other.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 46°. Find the measure of the co-interior (same-side interior) angle.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 51° and 35°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 96°. Find the consecutive angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 32. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 64, and it is parallel to the third side
16, and it is parallel to the third side
32, and it is parallel to the third side
16, and it is perpendicular to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that vertical angles are congruent. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The two lines are parallel, forcing the angles to match.
Each vertical angle is supplementary to the same adjacent angle, so both have the same measure.
The angles are congruent because they are opposite in position.
Vertical angles are congruent by definition.
